Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 3. The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 4. TOYOTA INNOVA CRYSTA (HIGH END VARIANT) VEHICLES ON LONG-TERM HIRE BASIS FOR A PERIOD OF 05 ( FIVE) YEARS FROM 01.01.2027 TO 31.12.2031 REQUIREMENT OF VEHICLES: S. Quantity R Type of Vehicle Period of Hire No. equired Toyota Innova Crysta (High End Varia nt), Diesel Manual, White Five Years (01.01.2027 1. 05 Nos. to 31.12.2031) Model :- GX Plus TERMS AND CONDITIONS Bidders interested in participating in the bid shall submit their offers subject to acceptance of the following terms and conditions: 1. The vehicles shall be provided without drivers and fuel on a monthly hired basis .

2. All vehicles shall remain in the custody of the Academy throughout the contract period, subject to the terms and conditions of the GeM contract. 3. All vehicles offered shall have been manufactured and registered on or after 01 .01.2026 and shall have covered not more than 20,000 kilometres as on the dat e of deployment. 4. All vehicles shall be BS-VI compliant and shall conform to the applicable emissio n norms and statutory requirements. 5. All vehicles shall be of white colour. 6. All vehicles shall have valid Comprehensive Insurance, including Third Party Ins urance, throughout the contract period. The vendor shall be responsible for tim ely renewal of the insurance policies. 7. All basic accessories, including seat covers, wheel covers, floor mats, mud flaps and other standard accessories, shall be provided by the vendor without any ad ditional cost to the Academy. 8. All maintenance and repair works, including regular servicing, replacement of t yres, batteries, engine oil, lubricants, filters and other consumables, shall be th e responsibility of the vendor throughout the contract period. No additional pay ment shall be admissible on this account. Any additional accessories, if required , shall be provided only with the prior approval of the Academy. 9. The Academy reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of vehicles as per its operational requirements, subject to the provisions of the GeM contra ct and mutual contractual obligations. 10.All vehicles shall preferably be registered with the Telangana Regional Transpo rt Authority (RTA). 11.In the event of breakdown, accident, mechanical failure or any other circumsta nce rendering a vehicle unfit for service, the vendor shall immediately provide a suitable replacement vehicle of equivalent or better category and specifications, without any additional cost to the Academy. 12.All vehicles offered by the bidder shall be owned or legally leased by the bidder . The bidder shall submit copies of valid Registration Certificates (RCs), Insuranc e Certificates, Fitness Certificates, Pollution Under Control (PUC) Certificates an d other applicable statutory documents before deployment of the vehicles. The bidder shall ensure that all such documents remain valid and comply with applic able statutory requirements throughout the contract period. The vendor shall b

e responsible for payment of all applicable road taxes, registration charges and other statutory dues relating to the vehicles throughout the contract period. 13.The Academy reserves the right to inspect all vehicles before acceptance and a t any time during the contract period to ensure compliance with the prescribed specifications and conditions. Vehicles not meeting the prescribed requirements may be rejected by the Academy. 14.The vendor shall ensure delivery and deployment of all 05 vehicles at Sardar V allabhbhai Patel National Police Academy, Hyderabad, on or before the commen cement of the contract period, in good working and roadworthy condition, along with all required documents. 15.The monthly rental quoted by the bidder shall be inclusive of all expenses towa rds maintenance, servicing, repairs, insurance, road tax and other applicable ex penses relating to the vehicles. No additional charges shall be payable by the A cademy on these accounts. Applicable GST shall be dealt with as per the GeM c ontract and prevailing statutory provisions. 16.The Academy reserves the right to terminate the contract in case of persistent unsatisfactory performance, breach of contractual conditions or failure to provid e the required vehicles/services, in accordance with the applicable GeM contrac t terms and conditions. 17.The vendor shall comply with all applicable provisions of the Motor Vehicles Act , Central Motor Vehicles Rules and other statutory regulations in force from tim e to time. 18.Any penalties or recoveries for non-performance, delay in providing replaceme nt vehicles or failure to fulfil contractual obligations shall be governed by the ap plicable GeM General Terms and Conditions and the provisions of the contract. 19.The decision of the competent authority of the Academy regarding satisfactory deployment and performance of the vehicles shall be final, subject to the applic able terms and conditions of the GeM contract. 20.All required maintenance, including tyres and battery replacement, shall be car ried out by the firm. However, any additional accessories required by the user s hall be as per requirement. All repairs and maintenance shall be the responsibili ty of the HIREE. 21.Vehicles shall remain at the disposal of the Academy on a 24×7 basis for five y ears, subject to satisfactory performance. The Academy may extend the contra ct beyond Five years in the interest of administrative necessity or economy.

22.The HIREE shall comply with all requirements prescribed by the State Transport Authority and other statutory laws. Any default shall be the liability of the HIREE , and the HIRER shall not be responsible. 23.If the contract is terminated due to violation of terms or deficiency in service, a dditional expenses incurred in hiring a new contractor may be recovered from t he performance guarantee. 24.No request for escalation of rates will be entertained during the contract period . 25.Failure to comply with statutory requirements or contractual terms may result i n termination of the contract and penal action as per contract provisions. 26.Vehicles shall remain stationed at the MT Section of SVP National Police Acade my, Shivrampally, Hyderabad during the contract period (24×7). 27.The supplier shall replace any vehicle immediately in case of breakdown or poo r condition. A replacement vehicle must be provided within 1–2 days in case of breakdown, accident, or maintenance. 28.The supplier shall be solely responsible for all liabilities arising from accidents, i njuries, or damages. 29.The Academy shall not be responsible for any compensation claims. 30.The bidder must have a registered office within Hyderabad / Secunderabad mu nicipal limits (The physical verification of the office location will be carried out b efore the award of the contract to the successful bidder), and valid proof of addr ess must be submitted. 31.The contractor should have at least 3 years of experience in executing similar works in Government Departments/PSU/ Private organizations, preferably in poli ce organizations. Proof of work orders executed during the last three years shall be enclosed along with the technical bid, and work satisfaction/completion certi ficates obtained from the concerned departments shall also be furnished. The bi dder must provide a valid service support certificate ensuring availability of vehicles and maintenance support within the required timeframe. 32.The contractor should have a minimum annual turnover of ₹ 01 Crore during each of the last three financial years. Proof of Income Tax Returns ( ITR) for the last three years shall be submitted along with the technical bid. The turnover must be supported by audited financial statements for the last three fi nancial years, duly certified by a Chartered Accountant. 33.The bidder shall submit a declaration stating that he/his agency has not been bl acklisted, debarred, or convicted by any Central/State Government or PSU for a ny reason, and that no case is pending against the firm with regard to vigilance, CBI, or FEMA matters. 34.The bidder must submit a signed declaration confirming acceptance of all tend er terms and conditions. 35.Past Experience of similar services – The bidder must have successfu lly executed / completed similar services over the last three years i.e., the current financial year and the last two financial years (ending month of M arch prior to the bid opening):- A. Three similar completed services costing not less than the amount equal t

o 40% (forty percent) of the estimated cost; or B. Two similar completed services costing not less than the amount equal to 50% (fifty percent) of the estimated cost; or C. One similar completed service costing not less than the amount equal to 80% (eighty percent) of the estimated cost. 36.A valid bank solvency certificate (not older than 6 months from the date of tend er submission) must be provided. . 5.
